samplingFinding: Twenty-nine of forty unseen query pages on twenty previously qualified training domains passed the frozen capture gates, a 72.5% page yield. Thirty attempts captured successfully; one captured page was rejected for exposing only seven candidate roots. The remaining ten attempts were two blocked annotations and eight navigation timeouts.
visualValidationFinding: All twenty-nine accepted full-page annotation views were inspected after capture and showed coherent query-result evidence. The 341 frozen roots span mass, volume, count, length, and area. They include explicit per-yard and per-square-foot prices; package-count versus physical-dimension ambiguity; starting prices, ranges, sales, kits, and samples; query-adjacent semantic hard negatives; and listings where the correct outcome is abstention because quantity or price binding is absent. Minor fixed widgets on Greatmats, Tileon, and Seattle Fabrics remained below the frozen twenty-percent obstruction limit and did not cover the selected evidence.
